svg.title: Customer need clarification funnel
svg.desc: A funnel moves from open questions, to listening for priorities, to checking constraints, to confirming the request, then matching an authorised product or service.
svg.text: Turn a broad request into an accurate service decision

g.text: Ask an open question: “What would work best for you today?”
Listen for purpose, preference and priority
Check dietary, access, time and price constraints
Match an authorised product or service
